motions.item_title: Authority to move into closed meeting
motions.text: That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to Section 239 (2) (a) of the Municipal Act relating to the security of the property of the municipality or local board.
motions.text_html: That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to Section 239 (2) (a) of the Municipal Act relating to the security of the property of the municipality or local board.

motions.item_title: 2022 Municipal and School Board Election Report, 2023-57
motions.text: That the report number 2023-57, titled 2022 Municipal and School Board Election Report, be received.
motions.text_html: 1. That the report number 2023-57, titled 2022 Municipal and School Board Election Report, be received.

motions.text: That the 2023 City of Guelph property tax ratios and corresponding tax rates, as set out in Attachment-2 to the report 2023-89 titled 2023 Property Tax Policy dated March 7, 2023, be approved.
motions.text_html: 1. That the 2023 City of Guelph property tax ratios and corresponding tax rates, as set out in Attachment-2 to the report 2023-89 titled 2023 Property Tax Policy dated March 7, 2023, be approved.

motions.text: That the Revenue Budgeting Policy attached to Report 2023-84 – Revenue Budgeting Policy, be approved.
motions.text_html: 1. That the Revenue Budgeting Policy attached to Report 2023-84 – Revenue Budgeting Policy, be approved.

motions.item_title: Transit Advisory Committee – Terms of Reference, 2023-40
motions.text: That the Terms of Reference for the Transit Advisory Committee dated January 19, 2023 be approved.
motions.text_html: 1. That the Terms of Reference for the Transit Advisory Committee dated January 19, 2023 be approved.

motions.text: That the One Canopy Tree Planting Strategy (TPS) dated January 2023, included as Attachment-1 to this report, and the proposed actions and recommendations noted within the plan be approved. That the funding requirements for the One Canopy Tree Planting Strategy be considered in future operating and capital budgets in order to implement the recommendations of the strategy.
motions.text_html:
1. That the One Canopy Tree Planting Strategy (TPS) dated January 2023, included as Attachment-1 to this report, and the proposed actions and recommendations noted within the plan be approved.
  2. That the funding requirements for the One Canopy Tree Planting Strategy be considered in future operating and capital budgets in order to implement the recommendations of the strategy.

motions.text: That staff be directed to create a new schedule under the City’s Business Licensing By-law (2009)-18855 to regulate the licensing of short-term rental accommodations that incorporates the recommendations contained within this report.
motions.text_html: 1. That staff be directed to create a new schedule under the City’s Business Licensing By-law (2009)-18855 to regulate the licensing of short-term rental accommodations that incorporates the recommendations contained within this report.

motions.text: That report titled ‘Internal Audit Work Plan 2023- 2025’ dated March 7, 2023 be approved.
motions.text_html: 1. That report titled ‘Internal Audit Work Plan 2023- 2025’ dated March 7, 2023 be approved.

motions.item_title: Implementation Strategy Report: South End Community Centre, 2023-64
motions.text: That the construction of the South End Community Centre be approved for a project cost of $115.5 million, with the project scope as approved under the October 7, 2020 report IDE 2020-141 South End Community Centre Project Update. That additional budget of $35.5 million be approved for project RF0092 South End Community Centre Construction, funded $33,725,000 from Parks and Recreation Development Charge Reserve Fund (#319) and $1,775,000 from tax supported debt funded from the Infrastructure Renewal Reserve Fund (#150).
motions.text_html:
1. That the construction of the South End Community Centre be approved for a project cost of $115.5 million, with the project scope as approved under the October 7, 2020 report IDE 2020-141 South End Community Centre Project Update.
  2. That additional budget of $35.5 million be approved for project RF0092 South End Community Centre Construction, funded $33,725,000 from Parks and Recreation Development Charge Reserve Fund (#319) and $1,775,000 from tax supported debt funded from the Infrastructure Renewal Reserve Fund (#150).

motions.text: That the meeting be adjourned. (7:16 p.m.)
